fields.description: Issue features extensive political commentary and investigative allegations targeting former Dade County state’s attorney Vernon Hawthorne, calling for grand jury scrutiny and criticizing the Miami Daily News. Major coverage argues against a proposed Florida legislative measure requiring signatures from 40% of registered voters to trigger a referendum affecting racing permits, warning it would entrench gambling interests and harm Miami business; includes discussion of racing interests tied to Joseph E. Widener and Col. E. R. Bradley and the transfer of Tropical Park. Also includes sports columns (racing tips, boxing notes, tennis tournament coverage), letters to the editor, and numerous local business advertisements.
